messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick org + hiring update — approved headcount and a small runtime split. TL;DR: +9 FTEs approved, Runtime team splitting into Runtime Core + Runtime Ops, leadership changes, recruiters assigned. More below.

alex-vp-eng: Huge — thanks folks for moving fast on the finance side. This will help latency/cost work ship faster. :clap:

maria-peopleops: Details: Finance signed off on 9 hires (distributed across Eng and SRE). Effective next Monday we'll create two teams under Eng Runtime: Runtime Core (model execution, kernels, compilation) and Runtime Ops (serving infra, autoscaling, rollout pipelines). We expect ~3 IC hires for Core, 3 for Ops, 2 SREs, 1 product ops.

sunil-patel: Congrats to everyone involved. I'll step into Director, Runtime Core to own the runtime architecture and kernel roadmap. Really excited to focus on throughput optimizations.

tanya-ramos: I'll split from the current Runtime lead role into Manager, Runtime Ops — will own deploy surface, autoscaling policies, and canary/rollback tooling. I'll be hiring two senior engineers and a staff SRE.

lina-chavez: Congrats @sunil and @tanya — happy to help with onboarding checklists and cross-team onboarding sessions.

jordan-kim: I'll coordinate product-side priorities and make sure the rollout policies & eval gating are covered. Will sync with @tanya on SLA targets.

jen-recruiter: Recruiting update: I'll open reqs today for: Senior Inference Engineer (x3), Senior Backend Engineer (Runtime Ops, x2), Staff SRE (x2), Product Ops (x1). Hiring timelines: target 6-12 weeks per bar/level depending on stage. I'll post JD links in #recruiting and tag hiring managers.

maria-peopleops: A couple of action items: 1) Hiring managers please add interview panel members in Greenhouse by EOD Thu; 2) People Ops will run salary calibration Thurs and post band guidance; 3) We'll do a short org AMA next Wed 10am PT (calendar invite out).

sunil-patel: For visibility, here's the provisional org layout:
```
Eng Runtime (split)
├─ Runtime Core (Dir: Sunil Patel)
│  ├─ Kernel & compilation (x3 hires)
│  └─ Model execution & quantization
└─ Runtime Ops (Mgr: Tanya Ramos)
   ├─ Serving infra (x2 hires)
   └─ SRE (x2 hires)
```

maria-peopleops: We're keeping existing reporting lines the same for now — this is a split for clarity, not a full reorg. Individual ICs won't be moved without 1:1s.

arthur-lim: delighted to join the team — I'll be onboarding into Runtime Core (contractor -> full-time conversion). Happy to jump into kernel profiling work.

jen-recruiter: FYI — interview rubric note: for Core roles prioritize low-level optimization + profiling exercises; Ops roles include deploy pipeline and incident runbook scenarios. I'll share sample take-home exercises.

lina-chavez: Small ask: can we reserve a brownbag slot for hires to present previous projects? Helps cross-team knowledge transfer.

maria-peopleops: Good idea, Lina — scheduling a "new joiner tech show-and-tell" the second Friday after hires start. Also, please use the standard intro template in #people-ops-intros so we have consistent bios.

jordan-kim: One more — Ops and SRE please coordinate runbook ownership before hires start so we can attach on-call rotations cleanly.

sunil-patel: Will pair with Tanya and SRE leads to draft rotation plan.

hr-bot: Reminder: submit role descriptions for salary calibration by 11:59pm PT Thu.

maria-peopleops: Thanks everyone. If you have objections to any of the role counts or suggestions on prioritization, drop them here or DM me. Otherwise I'll post final hiring plan + req links once Greenhouse is opened. :sparkles:
